items.title: Return signed enrolment agreement to accept the school place
items.quote: To accept the place, please sign both copies and return one of them to the admissions office by 06/07/2027.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar deadline '06/07/2027'. The sender is a German institution (German address, +49 phone number, German IBAN/BIC) writing to a family in Germany, so the date is in the European day/month/year convention, giving 6 July 2027. This is a private administrative deadline set by the school, not a statutory period, so no §187/188/193 BGB period counting applies and no extension for weekends/holidays is indicated by the letter; the date is taken as printed.

warnings: The deadline date '06/07/2027' is ambiguous between day/month and month/day formats; it was read as 6 July 2027 (European convention) based on the sender's German address and contact details, but this should be double-checked with the school.

The letter mentions a waiting list consequence ('After that date we will offer the place to the next family on our waiting list') which creates time pressure to accept quickly — a normal but worth-noting feature of enrolment offers.
